entries.title: Kind Trader
entries.prompt: A road trader offers a small favor if the party shares news from the south.

suggested.text: The party earned a small trader favor.

entries.title: Bad Weather
entries.prompt: Freezing wind slows travel and drains morale.

entries.title: Forgotten Cache
entries.prompt: A hidden cache sits under a loose stone.

entries.title: Tavern Rumor
entries.prompt: A drunk regular mutters about lights moving inside the old shrine.
entries.gmHook: Hand the GM a rumor card. Keep canon-risk yellow.

suggested.text: Lights inside the old shrine after midnight.
Rumor pinned for the GM's plot pile.

entries.title: Courier Request
entries.prompt: A travelling courier asks the party to deliver a thin wax-sealed letter on their next route.
entries.gmHook: If the GM accepts: thread the letter through the next scenario as a quest item.

entries.title: Stalled Caravan
entries.prompt: Two merchant guards block the road over a weighing dispute. They want a third party to call it.
entries.gmHook: The losing side becomes a low-hostility recurring NPC the next time the party returns.

suggested.text: GM: pick the side. Other side becomes hostile-light.

entries.title: An Old Friend
entries.prompt: Someone from before Bin's missing year recognises him by his walk and won't let him refuse a drink.
entries.gmHook: Free hook for filling Bin's lost year. Pin and develop later.

suggested.text: Bin gains a fragment of his missing year. GM picks the truth.

entries.title: Whisper Under the Bell
entries.prompt: Mitia hears a whisper inside the temple bell that no one else does. The bell rings only for her.
entries.gmHook: Plant Mitia's hidden lineage seed. Yellow. Promote only with consent.

suggested.text: The bell rings for one of the visitors.

entries.title: Garr's Old Mark
entries.prompt: A weathered post bears a hunter's mark Garr left years ago. The mark has been carved over.
entries.gmHook: Whoever covered the mark is a hook for an antagonist or rival.

suggested.text: GM: name the rival who carved over Garr's mark.

entries.title: Bowy's First Bow
entries.prompt: A pawnbroker shows Bowy a child's hunting bow with his initials scratched inside.
entries.gmHook: Free seed for an heirloom upgrade or a chapter about Bowy's village.

suggested.text: Bowy keeps the bow. GM: tie it to a future smith or village quest.
